fields.System.Title: CNT-301 — Calculate variance against the frozen snapshot
fields.System.Description:
Story

As an inventory controller, I want the difference measured against the snapshot taken when
the count started, so that variances mean something.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a submitted count, then variance is the counted quantity minus the snapshot
  • quantity — never minus the current balance.
  • - Given a multi-batch location, then variance is calculated per batch.
  • - Given a product found that was not expected, then it is a positive variance for that
  • product.
  • - Given an expected product not found, then it is a full negative variance, not an
  • ignored line.
  • - Given zero variance, then the task closes with no adjustment and the result is still
  • recorded for accuracy metrics.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | counting, inventory |
| Tables | count_result, variance, snapshot |
| Risks | Comparing against the live balance ([doc 09 §6.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
